summary: Re-tested the two previously reported frontend bugs plus regressions. Both fixes PASS end-to-end. FIX #1: clicking sector-apply-{entrepot|paysagerie|hotelier} on /offres now opens ApplicationDialog with the Secteur visé Select already pre-filled with the correct sector label (verified all 3 sectors). FIX #2: opening the Secteur Select inside the admin job dialog no longer produces the ResizeObserver error overlay — dropdown is fully interactive, sector can be picked, form saves, and the new job appears in the admin table. Regressions all pass: /admin redirects to /admin/login when logged out, admin login works, and end-to-end application submission from /offres produces the 'Candidature envoyée !' confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: index.js ResizeObserver suppression is correctly scoped (only stops propagation of benign RO messages) — safe pattern.
ApplicationDialog useEffect syncs sector from defaultSector when open toggles — correct; preserves user's manual choice if defaultSector is not provided.
AdminDashboardPage admin-job-sector SelectItems still lack per-option data-testid (non-blocking; labels can be matched by role=option name).
Auth login response uses 'access_token' field (confirmed from login API). Previous test report noted 'token' — /app/backend/tests/test_attouna_api.py already handles this correctly (24/24 pass).

success_rate.backend: 100% (24/24 from iteration_1; not re-run as per request)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_JOB_{timestamp} (paysagerie) via admin UI and one TEST_John/TEST_Doe application via /offres submission during the tests. All TEST_-prefixed jobs and applications were cleaned up via authenticated API at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both previously reported frontend bugs are verified fixed. ApplicationDialog defaultSector sync works for all 3 sectors. Admin job creation via Secteur Select works end-to-end with no RO overlay. No outstanding issues. Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_attouna_api.py and is self-cleaning.

rca of the issue.bug1_sector_not_prefilled: RESOLVED — ApplicationDialog.jsx now has useEffect([open, defaultSector]) that syncs form.sector from defaultSector when the dialog opens, so sector-apply-{sector} entry points pre-fill the Select correctly.
rca of the issue.bug2_resize_observer_overlay: RESOLVED — index.js registers window 'error' and 'unhandledrejection' listeners that stopImmediatePropagation+preventDefault on messages containing 'ResizeObserver loop', preventing CRA react-error-overlay from rendering the blocking iframe. Admin sector Select now opens and interacts cleanly.
